explanation: Backtrack by adding an opening bracket while some remain, or a closing bracket only when an unmatched opening exists. Every completed prefix is a balanced string, and each valid string is generated once.
timeComplexity: O(n^2 Cn) safe upper bound including copied prefixes, where Cn is the nth Catalan number.
spaceComplexity: O(n^2) auxiliary copied-prefix/recursion space, plus O(n Cn) output characters.
